name: mobile_menu_title
label: Mobile Menu Title
help_text: Heading shown at the top of the mobile slide-down menu.

name: mobile_close_label
label: Mobile Close Button Label
help_text: Accessible label for the mobile menu close (X) button.

name: mobile_close_icon
label: Mobile Close Icon
help_text: Upload SVG/PNG OR paste raw SVG for the close (X) button. Leave empty to use the default X icon.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. SVG preferred.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste raw <svg>...</svg> code. Leave empty to use the default X icon.

name: nav_items
label: Navigation Items
help_text: Add or reorder the sidebar navigation links. Each item needs a label, URL, and icon.

children.name: nav_label
children.label: Label
children.help_text: Text shown in the navigation (e.g. Dashboard, Services)

children.name: requires_partner
children.label: Requires Partner
children.help_text: Toggle ON to hide this item from contacts whose `partner` CRM property is not true. Use for the My Deals nav item (and any other partner-only links).

children.name: url
children.label: Page URL
children.help_text: The page this nav item links to

children.name: icon
children.label: Icon
children.help_text: Icon displayed next to the label. Upload SVG/PNG from Files Manager OR paste raw SVG code.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. Recommended: 20×20px SVG.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste the raw <svg>...</svg> code. Leave empty if using the upload field above.

children.name: chevron
children.label: Chevron / Arrow Icon
children.help_text: Arrow icon on the right side of the nav item. Upload SVG/PNG OR paste SVG code.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Chevron (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. Recommended: 24×24px SVG.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste the raw <svg>...</svg> code for the chevron/arrow.

name: tier_card_backgrounds
label: Member Tier Card — Tier Backgrounds
help_text: Upload one background image per tier (JPG or PNG). The right image is shown on the Member Tier card based on the logged-in member's tier value on their associated Referral record.

children.name: bronze
children.label: Bronze tier background
children.help_text: Shown when the member's tier is Bronze.

children.name: silver
children.label: Silver tier background
children.help_text: Shown when the member's tier is Silver.

children.name: gold
children.label: Gold tier background
children.help_text: Shown when the member's tier is Gold.

children.name: platinum
children.label: Platinum tier background
children.help_text: Shown when the member's tier is Platinum.

name: logout_label
label: Logout Button Text
help_text: Text shown on the logout link at the bottom of the sidebar.

name: logout_url
label: Logout URL
help_text: URL for the logout action. Default is the HubSpot membership logout path.

name: tier_heading_label
label: Tier Card Heading
help_text: Label above the tier name on the membership card.

name: next_tier_label
label: Next Tier Label
help_text: Text before the next tier name (e.g. 'Next Tier:').

name: current_points_label
label: Current Points Label
help_text: Label under the current points value.

name: for_tier_label
label: For Tier Label
help_text: Text before the target tier name in the progress section (e.g. 'For Silver tier').

name: tier_suffix
label: Tier Suffix
help_text: Word shown after the tier name (e.g. 'Silver tier').

name: more_points_label
label: More Points Label
help_text: Text after the remaining points count (e.g. '500 more points').

name: unlock_benefits_label
label: Unlock Benefits Label
help_text: Text before the tier benefits message (e.g. 'to unlock Silver tier benefits').

name: tier_benefits_suffix
label: Tier Benefits Suffix
help_text: Text after the tier name in the benefits message.

name: top_tier_message
label: Top Tier Message
help_text: Shown on the tier card when the member has reached the highest tier (Platinum). Replaces the Next Tier line and hides the progress bar.

name: untiered_display
label: Untiered (New Member) Name
help_text: Tier name shown when a member has no tier set yet. Bronze is earned once they complete their first qualifying service.

name: untiered_message
label: Untiered Message
help_text: Shown on the tier card for members with no tier yet, in place of the Next Tier line and progress bar.
default: Complete your first qualifying service to unlock Bronze.

name: points_suffix
label: Points Suffix
help_text: Abbreviation shown after point values (e.g. '1,000 pts').

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Leave empty to use theme default

children.name: padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Override the default text color for this module instance. Leave empty for theme default.

children.name: content_width
children.label: Content Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of this module's content.

children.name: hide_on_mobile
children.label: Hide on Mobile
children.help_text: Sidebar is always hidden on mobile (hamburger overlay used instead). This toggle is for edge cases.

children.name: hide_on_desktop
children.label: Hide on Desktop
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on desktop viewports.
